csv_project_name: IDIQ Engineering for Statewide Operational Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Georgia Department of Transportation may be seeking a consultant for Engineering Services to Regionalized Statewide Operational Improvement Contracts to include Contract 1, Districts 1, 2, 5, & 7 in DeKalb, Clayton, and Rockdale Counties (East Region); and Contract 2, Districts 3, 4, 6, & 7 in Cobb, Fulton, and Douglas Counties (West Region). The Consultant shall provide, on an on-call basis, engineering work to evaluate and address operational inefficiencies at intersections and along corridors throughout the state route system. The engineering work includes approach delay, intersection delay, network delay, capacity analysis, crash data analysis, safety data collection & analysis, review of best engineering practices, crash screenings, intersection control evaluations, plan development, benefit cost analysis, concept & alternative sketches, conceptual drawings, and identifying projects that meet requirements to be submitted for application to national and state funding
